mico.definition:
n. A small South American monkey (Mico melanurus), allied to the
   marmoset. The name was originally applied to an albino variety.

micodrepanocytic anemia.translation: [医] 镰状与靶状细胞性贫血

miconazole.definition: n an antifungal agent usually administered in the form of a nitrate (trade name Monistat)
miconazole.translation: [化] 咪康唑; 双氯苯咪唑
